goal: Set the sellable unit count at or below which single-SKU offer availability is reported as low_stock (low stock threshold, availability status, stock badge cutoff).
whyThisDefault: Twenty sellable units warns storefronts before an individual SKU hits zero while avoiding false low-stock warnings on normal replenishment buffers.

effect.appliesTo: Passed as lowStockThreshold (default DEFAULT_LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 20) to statusForSellableNow, deriveOfferAvailability, createOfferAvailabilityPort (@openlup/platform/commerce and /commerce/server), and createNewPurchaseStockAvailabilityPort (@openlup/platform/inventory). Positive stock <= threshold reports low_stock; 0 disables low_stock warnings. Non-integer or negative values reject at runtime.
frozenOn: Placed orders, active reservations, and already computed availability responses are unaffected.

runtime.reason: Configured in server availability port composition (lowStockThreshold option) and applied on deployment.

goal: Preserve the original reservation expiry on replay.

runtime.reason: A replay returns the existing hold without changing stock allocation or expiry.

goal: Set safety stock and channel exposure in available-to-promise calculations.

runtime.reason: Native available-to-promise currently uses zero safety stock and no channel allocation.
